title: Card, normal layout
description: A file in data/card/normal/. The ordinary layout has one set of face characteristics on the card record. Type-line words and mana symbols are represented by IDs from component lists. Rules text is held as structured abilities, not as a text block.

layout.description: The id of this card's layout in data/card/component/layout.json. A layout fixes which values a card has and how its faces are arranged. The folder the card sits in is named after it.

history.description: Records of official corrections to this card. Appended only; past records are never rewritten.
